items.headline: Extreme Heat Watch issued September 30 at 9:46AM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with temperatures up to 90 at the
coast and 105 in the valleys.

* WHERE...Coast and valleys of Los Angeles and Ventura Counties.

* WHEN...From Friday morning through Thursday, October 08.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Very hot temperatures are likely to continue
into the second week of October, possibly requiring an extension of
this product.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.

items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 29 at 1:45PM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Strong rip currents. Minor tidal overflows, especially
during the late morning high tides.

* WHERE...Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Ventura County
Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Pooling of sea water is possible around high tide at
beach and harbor areas that is uncommon with normal tidal
ranges. Enhanced beach erosion is also possible. No significant
damage is expected. Rip currents can pull swimmers and surfers
out to sea.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.
